pause.entry: START during RACE, UPGRADE, BOSS_APPROACH or FINAL_BOSS when transition mutex is free
pause.exit: START resumes, B returns to prior scene if menu policy allows
freezes: animation frame advance except pause cursor
pause.render_policy: WINDOW owner switches to pause overlay only after race_hud state is preserved

entry_conditions: pressure >= 100 outside protected boss final hit resolution
game_over.presentation: short result card with failure line from doc/12-roteiro.md

continue.product_target: 3 continues per run unless save/accessibility policy changes
continue.continue_action: restart current sector at checkpoint with score multiplier reset
continue.boss_continue_action: restart current boss phase with weakpoints already broken preserved only after save policy approval

scene_handoff.handoff: preserve race state, input buffer cleared
restore race state, resume timers next frame
freeze, clear hazards after result card
carry current sector id and checkpoint id
reload sector checkpoint, reset pressure to 25

blocked_behaviors: pause cannot enter during scene fade/load
continue cannot resume into stale hazard pool
game over cannot leave HScroll, WINDOW or sprites owned by race scene
input buffer cannot fire Pulse immediately after continue
validation_plan: title return clears all race resources
